name: Amafune Emiru
source:
The younger sister of the protagonist's girlfriend, Sayoko.

She is a student.

She is shy and has a difficult time socializing with other people, but also has a competitive personality that makes her act tough and stubborn.

She has been secretly attracted to the protagonist for a long time, and when they started to live together, she couldn't stop herself from going after him.
